chunks: Relate to them the plight of the man whom We gave Our signs, but he passed them by, so that Satan came after him, and he went astray.

key_terms.الْغَاوِينَ: the astray / those who go wrong
key_terms.فَانْسَلَخَ: but he passed them by / withdrew from them

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the man who passed by the signs in Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often interpreted as referring to Qarun (Korah), whose immense wealth and knowledge became a test that he failed by relying on his own power rather than divine grace. The phrase 'slipped away from them' (fan salakha minha) highlights the fragility of faith when it is not accompanied by humility and gratitude, serving as a cautionary tale for the faithful against the seduction of worldly status.
